Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Blend: How the input joins the trail history. over: bright input pixels replace the faded history (luma-keyed). add: input is added to the history. max: per-channel maximum of both.
Decay: Per-frame multiplier applied to the history. Lower fades trails faster; 1 never fades (with Add it accumulates without limit).
Scale: Per-frame scale of the history about the centre. Above 1 trails expand outward, below 1 they shrink inward.
Rotate: Per-frame rotation of the history in degrees. Positive and negative values spin opposite ways.
Translate: Per-frame shift of the history in units of 0.01 of the image (X, Y). Trails drift in that direction.
Huedrift: Per-frame hue rotation of the history in degrees, so trails change colour as they age.
Noiseamount: Strength of the noise displacement applied to the history lookup. 0 = clean trails, higher = wobbly, smoky trails.
Noisescale: Spatial frequency of the displacement noise. Higher gives finer wiggles.
Noisespeed: How fast the displacement noise evolves, in noise units per second.
Inject: Gain of the incoming source before it is blended into the trails. 0 adds nothing new.
Active: Off freezes the current frame; the history stops updating.
Reset: Pulse: clear the trail history to black.
Look: Look of the built-in test source used when in1 is unconnected. original: default colours. mono: black, bone-white and grey. A connected in1 is not recoloured.
Accent: 0-1 amount that tints one object of the built-in test source red. No effect on a connected in1.
